description: Search French AMF-regulated company disclosures (résultats, franchissements de seuils, information privilégiée, rachats d'actions, and similar) from Info-financière, the French Officially Appointed Mechanism. PREFER OVER esef_filing_search FOR FRENCH ISSUERS — this source is updated same-day, unlike the community ESEF index which runs months behind for French/EU filings. Identify the issuer with isin (most reliable), lei (frequently null — do not rely on it alone), or a free-text company name; narrow by date_from/date_to (ISO date, UTC) — date_to IS INCLUSIVE of that whole UTC day, so a single-day check sets date_from and date_to to the SAME date (e.g. both "2026-10-16" to get everything published that day); a date_from after date_to returns empty_reason:"empty_window" rather than a bare zero. ALL THREE ARE OPTIONAL — omit company/isin/lei entirely to get every issuer's filings in the date window in ONE call (paginate with limit/offset only if a single day's market-wide volume exceeds the 100-row limit); this is far cheaper than calling once per issuer for a multi-issuer daily check. company is matched against the AMF's own LEGAL-NAME field (e.g. "TELEVISION FRANCAISE 1", not "TF1") — a trade-name search that matches zero legal-name rows automatically retries against disclosure titles and the response says matched_via:"title" when that is what found it, so prefer isin when you have it. Bilingual issuers publish each release TWICE (fr + en, separate ids, same minute) — pass language to get one edition, or group results by the returned language_pair_key. subtype_of_information is normalised to a real null (some disseminators send the literal string "NULL"). Returns disclosure EVENTS — title, issuer, timestamp, and a PDF/document link — NOT extracted XBRL facts.

company.description: Free-text issuer name search, e.g. "TotalEnergies", "LVMH". Matches on the AMF's own LEGAL-NAME company field first; a distinct legal entity (e.g. a listed subsidiary) with a similar name may also match. If the legal name differs from the trade name you typed (e.g. "TF1" vs. legal name "TELEVISION FRANCAISE 1") and the legal-name match is empty, this tool automatically retries against disclosure titles — check matched_via and company_resolved in the response.

date_from.description: Only filings published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Filters on the actual AMF publication timestamp.

date_to.description: Only filings published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, INCLUSIVE — the last day you want included). For a single-day check pass the same date as date_from. The upstream API's own bound is exclusive of that day; this tool handles that internally by querying one calendar day past it, so you never need to add a day yourself.

isin.description: Issuer ISIN, e.g. "FR0013230950". The most reliable identifier in this dataset — prefer this over lei or company name when known.

language.description: Filter to one language edition when an issuer files bilingual pairs: "fr" or "en". Omit to get both (each language edition is a separate row with its own id).

lei.description: Issuer LEI (Legal Entity Identifier), e.g. "9695002GVC14VHLFIH85". Populated on many but not all rows — a miss does not mean the issuer has no filings; retry with isin or company.

limit.description: Number of filings to return (1-100, clamped if you pass more — the response reports limit_clamped_from when it does). Default 10.

name: amf_search_filings
title: Amf Search Filings
